name: Emaar Serenity Hills
summary: The project, developer (Emaar India) and Sector 86 location are confirmed. Our RERA number is correct for Phase 1 only, because Phase 2 is GGM/994/726/2025/97. Our carpet sizes of 1,183–2,079 sq ft are confirmed by one source. Major differences: possession is September 2032 on all sources, not December 2028. The project has 13 towers and 997 units on 25.9 acres, not 7 towers, 1,800 units and 27 acres. Portals start at ₹2.72–2.98 Cr, about 19–26% above our ₹2.2 Cr.
